AppState.description: The whole state tree sent in snapshots and modified by patches.

jobs.description: Running jobs and the most recent finished ones.

power.description: None: no power box is ready.

weather.description: None: no weather sensor is ready.

AppState.title: AppState

observer.description: Whether unpaired clients may watch (read only).

setup_required.description: No owner passphrase yet: set one up first.

CameraSettingsRequest.description: Only the fields present are changed.

region.description: A readout region, or "full" for the whole sensor.

CameraSettingsRequest.title: CameraSettingsRequest

bayer.description: Color filter pattern (e.g. RGGB); None for mono.

can_cool.description: The sensor temperature can be set (a cooled camera).

cooler.description: Cooler on; None if the camera has none.

cooler_power.description: As reported by the driver; units vary.

exposure.description: Seconds; the last one set or used through NOCS (INDI keeps none).

preview.description: Latest preview, from any exposure or loop.

remaining.description: Seconds left in the current exposure.

corrected.description: NOCS now uses the clients' time (offset over 5 s).

offset.description: Seconds the client is ahead of the system clock.

ClockRequest.description: The client's clock, sent when it connects.

utc.description: ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-10-30T23:10:05.120Z.

utc_offset.description: The client's time zone, hours east of UTC.

ClockRequest.title: ClockRequest

corrected.description: The system clock is more than 5 s off: NOCS uses the clients' time for frame times, nights and the mount.

measured.description: When it was last reported, UTC.

offset.description: Seconds the clients' clock is ahead of the system clock; None until a client reports it.

destination.description: "auto", "internal" or the id of a mounted destination.

device.description: INDI device name. When omitted, the device of this driver that offers the role's interface is used; required when there are several.

outputs.description: Power role only: what each output (dc:1, dew:2, variable:1…) is called and feeds.

port.description: Serial port for DEVICE_PORT, preferably a /dev/serial/by-id/ path.

label.description: Device model the entry is for (one driver, many models).

force.description: Slew even if the target is below the horizon.

error.description: Why the profile cannot be connected right now.

frame_type.description: Defaults to the camera's current frame type.

save.description: Defaults to true for the main camera; the guide camera never saves.

destination.description: Id of the destination it was saved to.

format.description: File extension sent by the driver, e.g. .fits.

id.description: Catalog id of the saved frame; None if it was not saved.

time.description: UTC, ISO 8601, when the image arrived.

volume.description: Label of the drive it is on.

Hello.description: First client message: the state epoch and version the client already holds, if any.
Hello.title: Hello

HorizontalGoto.description: Point at a place in the local sky (e.g. the zenith for flats); tracking stops.
HorizontalGoto.title: HorizontalGoto

IndiValueElement.description: Text (string), switch (bool), light (state name) or BLOB (metadata only).
IndiValueElement.title: IndiValueElement

LoopRequest.description: Expose repeatedly for previews (nothing is saved) until the job is cancelled.
LoopRequest.title: LoopRequest

flip.description: The mount flips by itself at the limit.

MountLimits.description: Limits the mount enforces itself, when its driver exposes them (read only).
MountLimits.title: MountLimits

alt.description: Degrees; from the driver, or computed when the site and time are known.

moved_by.description: Paired device whose slew pad holds the mount.

moving.description: Manual motion (slew pad), axis by axis.

site.description: Where the mount believes it is.

site_check.description: The mount's site against the active profile's.

site_sent.description: NOCS sent the site since the mount became ready.

slew_rate.description: Speed of manual motion, a name in slew_rates.

slew_rates.description: Slowest first, as the driver names them.

time.description: The mount's clock as it last reported it, UTC.

time_sent.description: NOCS sent the time since the mount became ready; go to waits for both.

groups.description: Frames by type, target and filter.

night.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the date at the start of the night.

zip_url.description: All its frames as one zip (add ?type=&target=&filter=).

feeds.description: Roles this output powers: switching it off is refused while one is busy.

label.description: Name shown instead of the driver's.

OutputRequest.description:
dc and usb outputs take ``on``; dew heaters ``on`` and/or ``duty``; variable
outputs a ``voltage`` (switching them on) or ``on: false``.

Switching an output off, or changing its voltage, is refused (409) while a role
it feeds is busy (any job, when the profile does not say), unless ``force``.
OutputRequest.title: OutputRequest

PadRequest.description:
What the client holds, repeated every 0.25 s while held; all null to let go.

The mount stops after 1 s without a message, when the socket closes, and on
any error; after such a stop the client must let go before moving again.
PadRequest.title: PadRequest

latched.description: Stopped by NOCS: let go before moving again.

PairRequest.description: Set up the owner passphrase (``/api/auth/setup``) or pair with it (``/api/auth/pair``).
PairRequest.title: PairRequest

current.description: Amperes, when the box measures this output.

duty.description: Dew heaters: power in percent; while off, what it gets when switched on.

feeds.description: Roles the profile says this output powers.

id.description: <kind>:<n>, numbered from 1 in the driver's order (ADR 0017).

label.description: The profile's label, else the driver's.

voltages.description: Variable outputs: the voltages it can be set to.

auto_dew.description: The box drives its dew heaters itself; None: it cannot.

histogram.description: 256 equal bins of the linear data (sampled), over where most of it is.

histogram_start.description: ADU at the lower edge of the first bin.

maximum.description: Brightest sampled value, ADU; may be above the bins.

minimum.description: Darkest sampled value, ADU; may be below the bins.

time.description: UTC, ISO 8601, when the frame arrived.

url.description: JPEG, at most 1920 px wide; immutable.

guiding.description: Optics of the guiding train (guide scope or OAG).

Region.description: Part of the sensor, in unbinned pixels.
Region.title: Region

device.description: Device node it points to now.

fs.description: Filesystem type, e.g. ext4 or exfat.

id.description: "internal", or the volume's filesystem UUID (or mount:<path>).

path.description: Directory frames are saved below, as NOCS/….

sd.description: On an SD card (slower, wears out sooner; still supported).

system.description: On the same disk as the operating system.

choice.description: "auto" (an external drive if any, else internal) or an id.

destination.description: Where the next frame would go; None if nowhere.

error.description: Why frames cannot be saved right now.

TrackingRequest.description: Only the fields present are changed.
TrackingRequest.title: TrackingRequest

dew_point.description: °C: the sensor's, or computed from temperature and humidity.
